scope: Post-hoc implementation and trajectory audit, not a new policy comparison. Policies and recorded outcomes were not changed.

findings.claim: S/P/SP/P-local cold uncertainty is 1; H0/H1 is sqrt(2). Calibration matches within declared pairs, not across all architectures.
Progress is six cumulative summaries. The allocation coordinate is n/(n+8); there is no recent-return window, remaining-catalogue fraction or GA population diversity input.

A first zero reward can increase P-local uncertainty from 1 to 1.22977 because the next progress vector activates previously unobserved coordinates; a missing reward raises it to 1.41857 without a model update.
Adaptive policies exhibit long same-workload unavailable-feedback streaks. Retaining unknown labels is correct; current allocation has no common availability/backoff mechanism.
SP uses one additive linear structure-plus-progress model. It has no structure-by-progress product terms. Hybrid progress coefficients are independent for each workload.

S assigns the same prediction and uncertainty to identical structural vectors, regardless of individual workloads previous outcomes. Ordinary order and concrete inputs are absent from the feature representation.

Saga and aggregate names, Saga pairs, interaction identities and event routes are categorical feature labels. They do not carry natural-language semantics or hidden outcomes. Their effect does not establish transfer to unseen applications.
The formal seven-arm matrix does not include AdaptiveUcbPolicy, the existing independent running-mean UCB baseline. P-local is a seven-coordinate per-workload regression, not that simpler baseline.
The uniform baseline selects active workloads uniformly and retains the same local GA. Reward counts configured impact, not family diversity, independent defects, or wall-clock efficiency.
Frozen historical maps retain different measurement provenance. Replay audits selection and learning against those labels, not common-runtime reproducibility.

coefficientCountCaveat: These count allocated coefficients, not statistically independent effective degrees of freedom. Collinearity and ridge regularization affect effective capacity.

missingFeedbackCaseDiagnosis.scope: Read-only diagnosis of retained observations and current source. No rescoring, execution or behavior change.
missingFeedbackCaseDiagnosis.explanation: The fifth criterion lacks concurrent command/copy provenance. The current CopiedUpdateSession.active method still marks hooks from a non-owner thread unsupported and returns without recording the normal row. Four other criteria are available for all 222 observations; historical reference fitness enabled four criteria, whereas the formal all-five replay requires the fifth too.
missingFeedbackCaseDiagnosis.recoveryAssessment: A score-only rescan cannot restore omitted provenance. Complete assessment of asynchronous paths needs scoped observer support and fresh representative execution; no claim that every missing-origin case requires the same fix.
